## About
Century Roofing and Construction works out of Rendon Bloodworth Rd in Fort Worth and serves the entire Dallas Fort Worth area. We do residential and commercial roofing, and we are not an out of town company chasing the last storm. We plan to be here for the lifetime of your roof.
Our process is simple. Our inspectors come out when it suits you, we help you file and explain the insurance paperwork, and then our crew gets to work. You can choose from composition shingle, stone coated steel, standing seam, slate tile, clay tile and aluminum.
In their reviews, customers have called Kevin honest and thanked salesman Michael McCorkle by name. Neighbors have given us a 5 rating on Google from 172 reviews.

## Services
- Free roof inspection: Our qualified roof inspectors meet you at your convenience to check your roof for possible damage.
- Insurance claim help: After your claim is filed, we meet with your insurance adjuster to inspect the property and help explain the paperwork.
- Roof replacement: We tear off the old roof and install the new one. Typical construction time is 48 hours or less.
- Roofing materials and colors: Composition shingle, stone coated steel, standing seam, slate tile, clay tile and aluminum.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. Once the claim has been filed, we meet with your insurance adjuster to inspect your property for damage and help explain the paperwork.

Q: How long does a roof replacement take?
A: Most homes can have the roof torn off and a new one installed in under 48 hours, depending on the size of the house.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are in Fort Worth and serve the entire Dallas Fort Worth area.
